_comment: Every component the ORISO-Helm umbrella chart deploys (a templates/<dir> or a Chart.yaml dependency) must appear here: either as the id of a box in site/public/service-map/index.html, or under 'excluded' with a reason. check.py fails when a new component shows up in ORISO-Helm and is not listed.

excluded.health-dashboard: Operator status page, not part of a user request path.
excluded.storybook: Developer component catalogue, not part of the running platform.
